registration.grader: local Math-Verify and upstream I3 Logic leaf verifiers for label truth, exact GSM8K and generated RLT end node
registration.primary_contrast: 0.5*(tanh(action-position SAE donor margin/4)-tanh(orthogonal sham donor margin/4))
registration.primary_location: first-pass endpoint inside the two-pass decode
registration.estimand: selector routing when the verified content is presented in opposite positions; open response is scored separately

sources.math_equivalence: math-verify 0.8.0, uses the i3-math last-box extraction and equivalence rule

preflight.independent_unit: canonical benchmark problem/source root; both answer orders clustered
preflight.limits: Normal-based power is planning only. Root and sham independence, symmetry, readout sealing, and the scientific effect floor require independent audits. Repeated outcomes within a root are never additional worlds.

source_roster.selection_rule: SHA-256 rank of frozen root ID, independent of native outcomes
source_roster.additional_control: Oakhaven action-position SAE decoder span used zero-shot

scope: Benchmark-derived paired selector readouts. Open-response accuracy uses a frozen small subset. All evidence is development-only.
